description.value: Sushi Boss is a sushi restaurant recorded in North Vancouver offering made-to-order rolls, bowls, and takeout. Its OSM record is sparse, and the only website found under this name operates exclusively in Indianapolis, Indiana, raising serious doubts about whether the two are the same business. A touring cyclist considering a stop here should verify the location independently before relying on this listing.

The URL was flagged as 'medium' confidence discovery, strongly suggesting the website does not belong to this OSM node. Because the website cannot be treated as evidence for this location, almost all amenity fields default to null; the only reliable evidence is the OSM tag `takeaway=yes`.
